prompt_strategy.value:
For the first 3 rounds, the bodies of the characters changed. However, the pattern of the colours of their hats, arms and shoes were consistently different. We simply created labels going in a top-down order, describing the colour of their hat, arms and shoes chronologically. So for example, we had "purple black yellow".

We had to change our strategy for the 4th round, where the characters were completely different. We struggled to really come up with any kind of consistent pattern for them. We tried to give ourselves a chance by using a similar system to the first 3 rounds - counting the number of arms and legs showing in each character. There were multiple characters that would've had the same labels, so we introduced a 3rd number to differentiate via memory afterwards. For example, if character1 had 1 leg and 1 arm showing and character2 had 1 leg and 1 arm showing, we would have "1 1 1" and "1 1 2".
